Adds an effect to the chain of a bus: a filter, EQ, echo, reverb, compressor, limiter, distortion or lo-fi. The effect works on everything that plays on the bus and on the buses that feed it, and keeps ringing after their sounds stop. See [Audio effects](Audio-Effects). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
world = CreateAudioBus()
muffle = AddAudioEffect(world, BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS)
AudioEffectParam muffle, BB_EFFECTPARAM_FREQUENCY, 800
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@param type  `BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS` to `BB_EFFECT_LOFI` (1 to 12) from the shipped include file audio.bb. `0`, which a `BB_` name is when audio.bb is not included, is a runtime error, and so is any other number.
@param position  Where in the chain it goes: `-1` (the default) at the end, `0` before the first effect, `1` before the second, and so on. A position past the end puts it at the end. Below -1 is a runtime error.
@return The effect, for [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam), [AudioEffectBypass](AudioEffectBypass) and [FreeAudioEffect](FreeAudioEffect). Effect handles are never the handle of a bus.
@gap The effects of a bus run in the order of the chain, then the volume of the bus is put on, and the result goes to the bus it feeds. A new effect starts with the defaults of its type.
